name: Accounting
description: A comprehensive Accounting bachelor's degree covering financial, managerial, tax, auditing, corporate, and international accounting, with business, finance, law, statistics, and data analytics foundations.
bio: Accounting is an academic program structured to develop knowledge, practical skills, and professional competencies in financial reporting, management accounting, taxation, auditing, finance, governance, and accounting data analysis.

disciplines.name: Introduction to Accounting
disciplines.bio: Introduction to Accounting develops essential knowledge and practical skills for accounting professionals through structured video lessons and applied study. Bibliografia de apoio: Introduction to Accounting: recommended academic reading (Academic reference search): Recommended academic references and textbooks for Introduction to Accounting, with topics aligned to the Accounting program. A disciplina Introduction to Accounting combina fundamentos, prática e revisão contínua para que você entenda a base antes de avançar para exercícios e aplicações reais. Como estudar do seu jeito: organize o conteúdo em tópicos, faça resumos com linguagem própria, resolva exemplos sem olhar a resposta e retorne ao material sempre que uma dúvida aparecer.
